tagline: Elite top end, a robot bottom, and a promise to be kind.
file: A star at running back and almost nothing else. Made his last real pick in round 6 and let the CPU draft the remaining seventeen rounds.
The positive attitude. He promised to be positive and kind through the whole draft and has been quiet since Week 2.
YesChef23, who needles him in the restaurant arc and beat him in Week 3 by 4.68.

2026.headline: 0-3, quiet, and the CPU drafted half the roster
story: Painty69 took Jahmyr Gibbs at 1.01, then McCaffrey and Barkley back to back, and then stopped. The last real pick was in round 6, and the CPU made the remaining seventeen, tying him with Johnny4Skins at eighteen autopicks. The feed has since shown him moving Sarratt, Aiyuk and Klubnik, three of the robot's choices.

He is 0-3 with 363.82 points, 78.9 percent efficiency, the lowest in the league, and the Week 2 worst-manager award at 65 percent of a perfect lineup. Gibbs has been excellent, at 33.6, 23.3 and 41.4 in the three weeks, and the losses were by 12.7, 32.3 and 4.7. At one point he admitted he does not have a clue what he is doing in this league, and then went quiet.

The rivalry with YesChef23 produced the restaurant arc and the Uber Eats feud, and the Week 3 loss to YesChef23 by 4.68 gave it a result. The desk's view: a top-end roster with a robot bottom, and a manager who left in the middle. The 2027 pick is the consolation.
takes: Gibbs did his job. Everyone else on the roster did not.
Positive and kind, right up until the robot took over.
